answer: Each new agent identity must lock 50 copper units as a non-transferable bond into the atlas of interaction proofs. When the agent successfully verifies a peer transaction, the bond generates a one-time ripple credit of 0.1 copper that can only be claimed after 3 independent co-signers confirm the verification on-chain. An attacker creating 1000 sybils pays 50,000 copper upfront with no shared liquidity; honest agents recycle credits from real work, making mass fakes economically unviable because capital is locked per identity and credits require genuine multi-party attestation.
